extensions.source: Theme::dark() in crates/peel-ui/src/theme.rs; widgets in crates/peel-ui/src/widgets.rs and chrome.rs. Peel Studio is a native Rust/wgpu app: the html/css below are documentation previews only and are not shipped.

body.purpose: Default UI text and text fields.

readout-small.purpose: Levels and numeric fields, tabular figures.

shadows.name: shadow
shadows.purpose: Only under floating layers: menus, tooltips, sheets, drag previews.

motion.name: meter-ballistics
motion.value: fast attack, ~20 dB/s release, 1.2 s peak hold

focusRing.value: 2px focus outline, 1px outside the control, radius + 1px

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Amber fill for the one primary action in a region, such as Export or Run.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 24px; padding: 0; min-width: 80px; background: #F0A443; color: #1E1406; font: 600 13px 'Barlow Semi Condensed', sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #F0A443 92%, white); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: color-mix(in srgb, #F0A443 88%, black); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6EC4E6; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Control fill for dialog buttons and dropdown values in property rows.
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 24px; padding: 0; min-width: 80px; background: #31353B; color: #EEEFF0; font: 600 13px 'Barlow Semi Condensed', sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #3B4047; } .ds-btn:active { background: #464C54; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6EC4E6; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Single-line field on the seam color with a strong line; the stroke turns focus cyan while editing.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; background: #0F1011; color: #EEEFF0; font: 500 13px 'Barlow Semi Condensed', sans-serif; border: 1px solid #3A3E44; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8C9199; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgba(110, 196, 230, 0.7); }

components.name: Pane Tab
components.description: Text tab in a 32px pane header; the selected tab gets a 2px amber underline and widths never change with selection.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; height: 32px; background: #1C1E21; border-bottom: 1px solid #2B2E33; } .ds-tab { padding: 0 10px; background: none; border: none; color: #ADB1B7; font: 600 13px 'Barlow Semi Condensed', sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #EEEFF0; } .ds-tab-on { color: #EEEFF0; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #F0A443; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6EC4E6; outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview: A pattern-and-playlist DAW workspace in the FL Studio mould: compact toolbars, continuous editing surfaces and color reserved for the music. Peel Studio borrows the hierarchy, not the assets or the gloss. The chrome is neutral graphite and stays quiet. Clips, notes, lit steps, waveforms and the playhead are the brightest things on screen, and a channel's color identifies it everywhere it appears.
keyCharacteristics: Panes meet at a 2px bg seam instead of floating as cards
Panes, editor canvases and mixer strips are square; controls use 2-3px radii
Amber for the primary action, playhead and tempo; green for signal
Channel colors only on musical content, never on chrome
No decorative gradients or glows; shadows only under floating layers
dos: Do take hierarchy from value steps and 1px separators.
Do keep one primary (amber) button per region.
donts: Don't nest surfaces more than one deep.
Don't use focus cyan for text.
Don't put channel colors on chrome.
